parsed.post: Discarding latest (1.067804) as it regressed from my best (1.025138). The lower LR of 0.06 seems to have hit a stability floor or requires better regularization. I'll try stacking WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 onto my best config to see if regularization helps maintain the gains from the 0.06 LR.
parsed.description: Stacking WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 onto the current best configuration (DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.06) to improve stability and regularization.
